Class CompilationAssert

java.lang.Object
org.assertj.core.api.AbstractAssert<CompilationAssert, Compilation>
be.imgn.gaia.processing.testing.CompilationAssert
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.assertj.core.api.Assert<CompilationAssert, Compilation>, org.assertj.core.api.Descriptable<CompilationAssert>, org.assertj.core.api.ExtensionPoints<CompilationAssert, Compilation>
public final class CompilationAssert extends org.assertj.core.api.AbstractAssert<CompilationAssert, Compilation>
AssertJ assertions on a Compilation. Every failure message lists all the diagnostics, so a failed test shows what javac said. 
assertThat(compilation).succeeded().hadNoWarnings();
assertThat(compilation).generatedSourceFile("example.FooInfo").contains("class FooInfo");
assertThat(compilation).failed().hadErrorContaining("not abstract").inFile("example/Foo.java").onLine(3);

    • generatedSourceFile

      public org.assertj.core.api.AbstractStringAssert<?> generatedSourceFile(String qualifiedName)
      Verifies that the source of a type was generated, and returns assertions on its text.
      Parameters:
      qualifiedName - the fully qualified name of the generated top-level type, or package-info after the name of the package, if any
      Returns:
      assertions on the generated source text
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if qualifiedName is not a qualified name, module-info or package-info
      UncheckedIOException - if the generated source cannot be read

    • generatedFile

      public org.assertj.core.api.AbstractStringAssert<?> generatedFile(JavaFileManager.Location location, String relativePath)
      Verifies that a file was generated, and returns assertions on its text, decoded as UTF-8. Meant for text files, such as sources and resources.
      Parameters:
      location - the location the file was generated in, such as StandardLocation.CLASS_OUTPUT for resources
      relativePath - the path of the file relative to the location, separated by /, such as META-INF/services/javax.annotation.processing.Processor
      Returns:
      assertions on the generated text
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if relativePath is empty or starts with /
      UncheckedIOException - if the generated file cannot be read
